text: That's a great plan, Lauri. A very sensible way to start is an ASP account — it's a dedicated savings scheme for first-time home buyers. You can save between 50 and 1,500 euros a month, and once you've made at least 20 approved deposits, you can apply for an ASP loan when your savings cover at least 10% of the home price.
